population: held half of the phase-1 patient and exact-signal components; retrospective development, not an independent test
compatible_endpoints: unchanged SPH V1 frozen endpoint mappings; absent compatible statement is not absence of clinical disease
risk: per-ECG mean binary error over that profile's compatible endpoints; risk is not top-1 error
decisions: released label set, including the original P8 fallback when it fires; an abstained ECG retains baseline predictions only for audit
aurc: right-step integral over attainable scored coverage, taking identical confidence scores as a single threshold group
technical_failures: not scored, not abstention, no prediction imputed

intervals.unit: patient components linked by exact signal
intervals.scope: fixed-policy abstention and coverage, risk, baseline and accepted endpoint-macro F1, their paired difference and AURC; not uncertainty of threshold fitting

promotion: no external or clinical promotion from this retrospective experiment
